notes.title: Ezrebeth, our new full-length visual novel, is out now!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45188600/59dbc37ccb8dd49ae522bacc8e04001b33b361d5.png

Rise and shine, Dwellers!

Ezrebeth is finally here!

Experience the most surreal Tymedust Games story yet, offering a time-bending narrative of truly memorable proportions...

“Many twists and turns, with a lot of depth to the characters.”
- Hidden Gem Discovery

“An intriguing and unusual story, gripping with its superb writing and distinctive artwork. Highly recommended.”
- Critiques Sans Frontiers

“An overall display of tragedy, the clash of humane and inhumane, love and inability to love, mundane and the divine, and the great incompatibility of the two options.”
- User Review

We've also put together two bundles at reduced price points if you're looking to complete your collection of games and soundtracks from us: Pitstop in Purgatory + Ezrebeth Duo Pack and Purgatoryverse Complete Pack.

Thank you so much everyone for your support, and we hope you'll enjoy this brand new story of ours!

All the love,
Tymedust Games
